title.narrative: Strengthen the prevention +Manag of undernutrition Imprest Request No. 20

description.narrative: The Strengthening the prevention and management of undernutrition through an integrated programme in Moyamba, Sierra Leone project in Sierra Leone implemented by Action Against Hunger aims to improve the nutritional status of children under 5 years and adolescents, pregnant and lactating mothers. The objective of the project is to contribute to the reduction of undernutrition in children under 5 years, and improve the nutrition status of children <5 years, pregnant, adolescents, and lactating mothers. The key activities include support to community structures, health and nutrition education awareness, raise incomes through the VSLA approach, capacity strengthening for health care providers and is delivered in partnership with Movement Towards Peace and Development Agency-Sierra Leone (MOPADA-SL).
